title: Japanese-focused domestic translation AI PLaMo Translate reaches cutting-edge model performance with update
key_facts: Preferred Networks announced on 7 Oct 2026 a major update to PLaMo Translate, a Japanese-focused translation service.
The base PLaMo model moved from generation 2 to generation 3, trained for translation with hundreds of times the compute of the previous generation.
The company says Japanese translation now matches Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra and beats DeepL and Google Translate.
The company says its cost is under a tenth of competitors' cost.
Languages expand from Japanese and English to 53; a meeting translation bot covers 15 languages in Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams.
Open-weight versions of the third-generation model are planned under the PLaMo Community License.
quote_evidence: これにより、Claude Fable 5.1やGPT-6 Astraといった最先端モデルと同等、DeepLやGoogle翻訳以上の日本語翻訳精度を実現したとする。
あわせて、効率的に日本語を処理する仕様などを導入することで、利用コストを競合と比べて10分の1未満に抑えたとする。
Preferred Networksは10月7日に発表したもので、すでに利用可能となっている。
why_it_matters_hint: A Japanese-built translation tool may serve Japanese speakers at lower cost, but all figures are the company's.
notes: Read from PC Watch (Japanese, 727 chars, short article). Figures are Preferred Networks' own claims, not independently tested.
